description: Switch an Auto Scaling Group from EC2-only health checks to ELB health checks with a grace period long enough for the app to actually finish booting before it's judged unhealthy
prompts: main.tf's aws_autoscaling_group.web only checks EC2 instance status (health_check_type = "EC2"), which considers an instance healthy the moment the VM boots - even if the application inside is still starting up and failing every request, or is failing its target group health check entirely. Change health_check_type to "ELB" (so ASG health is driven by the actual application-level health check reported by its target group, not just "the VM is running") and set health_check_grace_period to 120 seconds (long enough for the app to finish its ~90 second startup sequence before ELB health results start counting against it - a 0 or too-short grace period would terminate slow-starting instances in an endless replace loop). Keep every other existing attribute unchanged.

test_setup_files.check_asg.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

content = open('main.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()

asg = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_autoscaling_group"\s+"web"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert asg, 'aws_autoscaling_group.web not found'
block = asg.group(1)

m = re.search(r'health_check_type\s*=\s*"(\w+)"', block)
assert m, 'health_check_type missing'
assert m.group(1) == 'ELB', f'health_check_type must be ELB, got {m.group(1)}'

m = re.search(r'health_check_grace_period\s*=\s*(\d+)', block)
assert m, 'health_check_grace_period missing'
grace = int(m.group(1))
assert grace >= 120, f'health_check_grace_period is {grace} - too short for a ~90s app boot'

assert re.search(r'min_size\s*=\s*2', block), 'min_size changed'
assert re.search(r'max_size\s*=\s*6', block), 'max_size changed'

print('PASS ASG health check checks')
